c3.name: C3
c3.release_year_status: First public design/prototype appearance established in2019; first functional or versioned compiler release year is not proven by retained release history.
c3.release_year_basis: The designer publicly shared the draft language in July2019 and the unfinished compiler in November2019. Official repository creation is2019-07-31. c3.language_typing: Static runtime types with local type inference; compile-time value variables may change type.
c3.typing: Static runtime types with local type inference
c3.typing_basis: Inference from official specification: runtime variable declarations bind a specified/inferred type during semantic analysis; dynamic rebinding is explicitly reserved for compile-time value variables.
c3.style: Procedural general-purpose systems language with C-like syntax/semantics, modules, generics, value methods and semantic macros.

planned_study_memory.label: Manual allocation with explicit heap ownership; temporary regions available
planned_study_memory.language_memory_strategy: C3 is manually managed and supports stack values, explicit heap allocators and temporary region allocators; it has no default tracing garbage collector.
planned_study_memory.planned_benchmark_policy: Authored candidate uses explicit alloc/free and std growable HashMap initialized with the immutable &allocators::LIBC_ALLOCATOR. Workers retain distinct heap-owned map fields through actual joins before the parent traverses/frees them; no temporary-allocator map is transferred between threads. Native source and lifetime qualification remains pending.
planned_study_memory.planned_general_library_storage: Generic GMP6.3 for unbounded Pi arithmetic and generic PCRE2 for regex; these are explicit source/library dependencies rather than language GC.
